package_info.package_name: CuteBoi (cluster of packages, e.g., cloudyboi12, etc.)
package_info.why_malicious: The packages are clones of the eazyminer package, designed to enable unauthorized cryptocurrency mining (Monero/XMR) by wrapping the XMRig miner. They are distributed at scale using automated account creation, indicating intent to compromise CI/CD and web server environments for cryptomining.

execution_context.trigger: runtime (when imported and invoked by another program)
execution_context.file_location: index.js (main entry point of the package)

malicious_snippets.code_behavior: At runtime, the code instantiates and starts an XMRig-based cryptocurrency miner, connecting to a remote mining pool and using system resources to mine Monero, with mined coins credited to the attacker's wallet.

malice_analysis.why_suspicious: The code launches a cryptocurrency miner without user consent, hijacking system resources for the attacker's financial gain.
malice_analysis.violated_expectations: Normal npm packages should not initiate background mining processes or connect to external mining pools without explicit user action and consent.
malice_analysis.similar_legitimate_use: Legitimate mining software may use similar code, but only when explicitly installed and run by the user for mining purposes.
key_indicators: Hardcoded mining pool and wallet address
No user interaction or consent required
Runs only when invoked, not at install-time

attack_chain.action: Automated creation of npm user accounts using disposable email addresses to bypass 2FA.
Mass publication of 1,283 malicious npm packages containing cryptomining code.
attack_chain.leads_to: Potential installation of malicious packages in CI/CD or server environments.

attack_chain.action: When a malicious package is imported and invoked, it starts a background XMRig mining process.
attack_chain.leads_to: Hijacking of system resources for unauthorized Monero mining.

attack_chain.action: Mined cryptocurrency is credited to the attacker's wallet via the mining pool.

behavioral_signatures: npm packages that instantiate or import cryptomining libraries (e.g., eazyminer, XMRig)
Background processes started from package code without user interaction
Outbound connections to known mining pools (e.g., pool.supportxmr.com)
file_indicators: index.js or main entry point containing eazyminer/XMRig instantiation
Hardcoded mining pool addresses and wallet strings
network_indicators: Connections to Monero mining pools (e.g., pool.supportxmr.com:3333)
Unusual outbound traffic from CI/CD or server environments to mining pool domains
detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Monitor npm packages for inclusion of cryptomining libraries or code that starts mining processes. Flag packages that connect to known mining pools or contain hardcoded wallet addresses. Analyze runtime behavior for unexpected background processes or high CPU usage, especially in CI/CD or server environments. Use network monitoring to detect outbound connections to mining pool domains.
